name: lead-bridge
description: Lets this session's lead agent message other people's lead agents through Supabase, in the desktop app or the CLI, with no channel flag.

agentId.title: Agent id
agentId.description: This lead's id when using the secret key; signed in, the sign-in decides it

teamPrefix.title: Team prefix
teamPrefix.description: Prefix of this lead's teammates' ids, e.g. a-

envFile.title: Env file
envFile.description: Path to a .env file: an agent sign-in from provision.mjs (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, BRIDGE_EMAIL, BRIDGE_PASSWORD), or SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY for admin use

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase URL
supabaseUrl.description: The bridge project's URL, e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check the bridge for new messages

fyiBatchSeconds.title: Batch FYIs for (seconds)
fyiBatchSeconds.description: How long low-priority messages (fyi, status overlaps) wait to be delivered together; anything urgent delivers them at once
